name: JSK Investments
decision_note: Investment group of the Kijonka family with its own capital (self-managed SICAV with Private & Growth Equity, Venture Capital and Family Evergreen sub-funds); active in startups (Vetstor Dec 2025, MintNeuro Oct 2026) but primarily a multi-strategy private investment group - borderline, see notes.

legal_entities.name: JSK Investments Venture Capital Fund I, podfond
JSK Investments Private and Growth Equity Fund I, podfond
JSK Investments Family Evergreen Equity Fund I, podfond

evidence.quote: Jsme investiční skupina s vlastním kapitálem a zkušenostmi z budování úspěšných firem.
Podporujeme inovativní startupy, zavedené podniky i rodinné projekty.
Investiční fond JSK Investments SICAV a.s. se zapojil do investičního kola britské společnosti MintNeuro, v němž firma získala 5 milionů USD.
Výčet investorů doplňuje investiční skupina JSK Simony Kijonkové a jejího manžela Jaromíra Kijonky.
V rámci Private & Growth Equity se zaměřujeme na majoritní kapitálové vstupy do středně velkých firem napříč tržními sektory.

analyst_notes: BORDERLINE: JSK presents itself as an investment group with its own capital (CVCA, e1) supporting startups, established companies and family projects (e2). Since 2025-2026 it runs a self-managed SICAV (JSK Investments SICAV a.s., ČNB-authorised above the threshold) with a Private & Growth Equity sub-fund (majority stakes in mid-size companies, e5; public offering of shares), a Venture Capital sub-fund (IČO 75166372, registered 2026-02-24; its investment director is quoted on the MintNeuro deal) and a Family Evergreen sub-fund. Startup deals: Vetstor EUR 1m round (Dec 2025, CzechCrunch) and MintNeuro USD 5m round led by Odyssey Ventures (release dated 2026-10-09; the homepage listing shows 10.10.2026). Typed private_investor with secondary vc and pe and excluded S1 per the brief for private investment groups; if the reviewer treats the VC sub-fund as a stand-alone Czech VC, the record should be re-typed vc and included (activity and legal entities are already evidenced). Facts (focus, ticket, capital) were not researched further.
